description: Tamil Nadu has partnered with Sarvam AI to establish a Rs 10,000 crore Sovereign AI Park, aiming to create 1,000 deep-tech jobs. This initiative will build an independent AI ecosystem within the state, fostering local talent and ensuring data sovereignty.
body_lead: The Tamil Nadu government on Tuesday said it has signed an agreement with Sarvam AI to establish a full-stack Sovereign AI (artificial intelligence) Park. The project will involve an initial investment of Rs 10,000 crore and will generate 1,000 high-skilled, deep-tech jobs, the government said. “This partnership is about building AI that is trained, deployed and governed in Tamil Nadu, for the world," Pratyush Kumar, cofounder of Sarvam AI, said in a statement.
